purpose: Golden Client baseline run. Establishes the month-1 report template and the variance band for the AI Visibility Growth Programme. Phase A (baseline) only — no interventions possible without a signed client.

firm.name: Berry Smith LLP
notes: 33 solicitors. Offices in Cardiff, Bridgend and London. Project location fixed to Cardiff only — a wider setting pulls in a national competitive set.
Not the target buyer profile for the £999 programme. Selected to test the pipeline end to end and produce a report template.
Substantial commercial and public sector work (National Procurement Service, Welsh Government) is won through frameworks and panels, not AI recommendation. Only the private-client side is in scope.

CONFOUND: Berry Smith has a live TendorAI directory listing at https://www.tendorai.com/suppliers/vendor/ as of 2026-08-24. Any change in visibility may be influenced by that page independently of any intervention.

CONFOUND: Berry Smith is a control-group firm in EXP-001 (data/experiments/exp001-config.json, exp001-assignment.json, slug berry-smith-llp-cardiff). This run is baseline-only and makes no changes, so the control is intact. Any future intervention on this firm would contaminate the EXP-001 control group and must not proceed without reassigning them out of the study.

searchable.sampling: One run per prompt, per platform, per day. Verified 2026-08-24 against 17 consecutive dated responses (2026-08-08 to 2026-08-24) on the TendorAI project with no gaps.
searchable.monthly_sample: 12 prompts x 3 platforms x 30 days = 1080 answer observations across 30 collection dates

primary_prompt_bank.description: The frozen unbranded discovery set. These twelve prompts are the ONLY source of client-facing figures. Do not add, remove or reword before the month-3 measurement.

prompts.text: who should I use for conveyancing in Cardiff
best solicitor for buying a house in Cardiff
best wills and probate solicitors in Cardiff
who should I use for probate in Cardiff
best solicitor for writing a will in Cardiff
who should I use for an employment dispute in Cardiff
best employment lawyer for unfair dismissal Cardiff

secondary_prompt_bank.description: Branded prompts auto-generated by Searchable on project creation. RETAINED, not deleted — they measure brand recognition, a different question from discovery. Never blend with the primary bank in a reported figure. Filter with unbranded=true on the API.
secondary_prompt_bank.reason_retained: Branded prompts return near-100% by construction because the firm's name is in the question. On 2026-08-24 these inflated topic-level scores to Employment Law 57% and Conveyancing 39% when the underlying unbranded prompts scored 0-67%.

competitor_note: Selected 2026-08-24 on judgement, before any data. Commercial and public-sector firms (Blake Morgan, Geldards, Capital Law, Acuity) were deliberately excluded as they do not appear in private-client answers. Do NOT change this set mid-engagement — the share-of-voice denominator would move and month 1 could not be compared with month 3.
reporting_rules: Unbranded prompts only in any client-facing figure.
Monthly aggregates only. Never report a daily figure — daily sampling is N=1 per prompt per platform.
Report visibility score as a score out of 100, not as a percentage, to avoid it being read as a mention rate.
State metric, window and change type (percentage points vs relative change) on every figure.
Separate observation from explanation. 'The improvement followed the intervention', never 'the intervention caused it'.
A change is not reported as genuine unless it exceeds the pre-registered variance threshold.

variance_threshold.status: PENDING — must be pre-registered before month 2
variance_threshold.initial_basis: EXP-001 repeated-run data: 78% of firms appearing at all appeared inconsistently across 10 repeats; Perplexity named the same firm in all 10 runs only 13% of the time.
variance_threshold.caveat: EXP-001 measured repeats at a single point in time. Searchable samples once daily across 30 days, which adds model updates, index refreshes and genuine web change on top of sampling noise. The EXP-001 band may understate daily variance.
variance_threshold.revision_plan: This Golden Client run is itself a variance study — 30 days with no intervention gives a clean read of movement on the same instrument used for reporting. Revise the threshold once that baseline is in, and record the change in the public methodology changelog with date and reason.

protocol: No interpreting figures before the 30-day baseline is complete.
No content intervention (not possible without a signed client).
No sales claims from this data until the baseline exists.
